title: Solving the Hamilton Cycle Problem fast on Average
authors: Michael Anastos (Institute of Science and Technology Austria, Austria)
abstract: We present CertifyHAM, a deterministic algorithm that takes as input a graph G and either finds a Hamilton cycle of G or it outputs that such a cycle does not exist. If $G\sim G(n,p)$ and $p\geq \frac{100\log n}{n}$ then the expected running time of CertifyHAM is $O(\frac{n}{p})$ which is best possible. This improves upon previous results due to Gurevich and Shelah, Thomason and Alon and Krivelevich who proved analogous results for $p$ being constant, $p\geq 12n^{-1/3}$ and $p\geq 70n^{-1/2}$ respectively.
